tutorials.title: Agentic Coding: The Future of Software Development with Agents
tutorials.description: 37-minute talk by Armin Ronacher describing his adventures with Claude Code and agentic coding methods. Covers how to make use of these new tools, where they are strongest, and where they are still lacking.

tutorials.title: Using Claude Code to build a GitHub Actions workflow
tutorials.description: Screencast showing how Simon used Claude Code to put together a simple GitHub Actions workflow. Demonstrates adding a small feature to a GitHub repo - an automatically updated README index listing other files in the repo.

tutorials.title: Claude Code Beginner's Tutorial: Build a Movie App in 15 Minutes
tutorials.url: Not found via search (referenced on Class Central and Creator Economy)
tutorials.description: Comprehensive tutorial teaching how to build a movie discovery app with watchlist functionality using Claude Code. Covers installation, plan mode, and persistent project memory techniques.
topics: Installing Claude Code in terminal and Cursor
Using plan mode for detailed specs
Initializing claude.md for persistent project memory

tutorials.title: Claude Code Beginners Guide 2025
tutorials.url: Not found via search (mentioned on X/Twitter)
tutorials.description: Beginner-focused tutorial covering Claude Code essentials from setup to mastering Plan Mode and project-specific memory management. Shows how to set up in Cursor, add context, use slash commands, and paste images.
topics: Setting up Claude Code in Cursor

tutorials.title: Advanced Guide to Claude Code: Memory, Plugins & More
tutorials.description: Edmund Yong's video guides covering Claude Code's most powerful capabilities, including memory management that eliminates redundancy and sub-agents that delegate tasks with precision.

tutorials.title: Claude Code Masterclass for Beginners
tutorials.description: Masterclass covering how to get fully set up with Claude Code, including GitHub and Cursor integration. Covers building your first landing page and introduces revolutionary 'plan mode' where Claude Code strategizes its development process.

tutorials.title: Claude Code: A Highly Agentic Coding Assistant
tutorials.description: Short course built in partnership with Anthropic, taught by Elie Schoppik (Head of Technical Education at Anthropic). Andrew Ng described Claude Code as his 'personal favorite coding assistant right now.'

tutorials.title: ChatTube: Chat with any YouTube Video with Claude AI & RAG
tutorials.description: Tutorial for creating a personal chatbot to chat with ANY YouTube video in 15 minutes using Claude AI API and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). Covers establishing connection using Claude API with Langchain, using pytube to interface with YouTube videos and whisper to transcribe audio to text.

tutorials.title: Teach Claude to Watch YouTube videos and Take Notes in Notion
tutorials.description: Tutorial teaching how to integrate Claude with YouTube video processing and Notion for automated note-taking. Demonstrates practical automation workflows using Claude's API.

tutorials.title: Claude Code in Action
tutorials.description: Official Anthropic training providing comprehensive training on using Claude Code for software development tasks, covering the underlying architecture of AI coding assistants, practical implementation techniques, and advanced integration strategies.
